behavioral_responses.response: During my internship at OK Zimbabwe, I faced a challenge automating a legacy workflow. I broke the problem down, researched Python automation libraries, and built a tool that saved the team 5 hours per week.

I believe in open communication. working on the Campus VibeMarket app, we had conflicting ideas on UI design. I organized a user testing session which provided data to make the final decision objectively.
I take initiative by identifying gaps. At university, I often lead study groups and help organize coding resources for my peers in Computer Systems Engineering.

technical_deep_dives.python: I use Python for both data analysis (Pandas) and backend web development (Django/Flask). I focus on writing clean, PEP-8 compliant code.
technical_deep_dives.django: My experience with Django includes building the Asset Management System, handling ORM relationships, and implementing user authentication.
technical_deep_dives.flutter: I use Flutter for cross-platform mobile development, managing state effectively and integrating with Firebase for backend services.
